supabase._comment: Enable when BMAD picks Supabase as the DB. Requires SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN and SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF.

gortex._comment: Code-intelligence graph over this repo (replaces CodeGraphContext + GitNexus). Installed by mise (see mise.toml) and resolved through its shim on PATH, then indexed by postCreateCommand; bare `gortex` also resolves for host users who installed it themselves. Enabled by default — it needs no credential and binds no port.
